label: reuse per-layer pipeline coordination tickets
hypothesis: Reuse pipeline GroupTicket objects and their threading events per shape instead of allocating24 tickets and48 Python events for each call; reset state under the existing serialized forward lock.
expected_bottleneck: Frozen A0001 coordination profiles attribute0.029966/0.032549 ms CPU to24 ticket constructions at b1/b8. Small potential gain; resetting events may cost as much. A0007 tensor-view caching was rejected and is not included.
change: Preallocate ticket pool, reset only completed CPU-generation state, tag slot previous references with forward generation. Across calls all previous CPU releases are already submitted, but copied/consumed CUDA dependencies remain mandatory. No tensor view/value cache or buffer-capacity change.
tradeoffs: Persistent Python synchronization objects increase retained host metadata.
Incorrect epoch handling can deadlock on a cleared old release event or reuse a GPU slot too early; test cross-call/cross-stream generations and failed-forward poisoning.
Potential saving is only tens of microseconds and may remain below independent model noise.
arithmetic_contract: Control-metadata reuse only; bit-exact folded-reference output and fresh lookup every call.
primary_target: b1/b8 prefill; unchanged bulk decode cannot nominate gain
draft_condition: Activated from verified A0016 after A0019 screen rejection and code-only reversion. New ticket tests appended, preserving all A0016 tests. No A0017/A0018/A0019 changes retained.
draft_validation: Syntax compile only; generation/stream safety and cancellation need GPU runtime gates before timing.
